ddl.where: status = 'pending' and token_hash is not null
ddl.name: invite_pending_email_idx

ddl.value:
(
				("coc_report_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
				+ ("volunteer_signup_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
				+ ("lunch_and_learn_idea_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
				+ ("coffee_table_group_request_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
			) = 1
ddl.name: submission_event_exactly_one_subject

ddl.value:
("reason" <> 'monthly_accrual' OR "period_key" IS NOT NULL)
				AND ("reason" <> 'spend' OR "invite_id" IS NOT NULL)
				AND ("reason" NOT IN ('refund_cancelled', 'refund_expired') OR "invite_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: volunteer_invite_ledger_reason_keys
